capsules.title: PMI insights every senior professional should know.
capsules.lede: Quick, useful facts across PMP, PgMP, PfMP and PMI-RMP, from eligibility to renewal.

items.title: Why PgMP is rare
items.text: Fewer than 7,000 professionals worldwide have earned PgMP. The credential is designed for leaders managing strategic programs, not individual projects.

items.title: PfMP: exec-only
items.text: Held by fewer than 2,000 professionals globally, PfMP recognizes leaders responsible for enterprise investment decisions and strategic value realization.

items.title: PMI-RMP rising
items.text: While millions manage projects globally, only a small fraction have earned PMI-RMP, demonstrating advanced risk management capability.

items.title: Renewal cadence
items.text: PMP requires 60 PDUs over 3 years. Our PDU Course is a PMI-approved 60-hour program to help you claim them.

items.title: Application is the gate
items.text: For PgMP and PfMP, most candidates fail at the application, not the exam. We coach narratives line by line.

items.title: Exam Readiness
items.text: Knowing the content is important, but success often depends on applying PMI's mindset to complex situational scenarios.

items.title: Audit Ready
items.text: PMI may audit your application, requiring verification of education and experience claims.

items.title: Center-Based Exam
items.text: PfMP candidates must appear at an authorized Pearson VUE test center, as remote exam delivery is currently not offered.
